title: First run
given: Clean install, no config, no CLI

steps.action: Launch Kluis from the app menu
steps.expected: Window opens on Welcome · Step 1 of 3; Back disabled; Next disabled
Button shows “Downloading…” (fixed width), progress “x of y MB” within 300 ms
“✓ Downloaded · proton-drive <latest> · SHA-512 checksum matches”; Next enabled
Step 2 of 3 · “Open Proton sign-in”; KDE note visible only on KDE

steps.action: Click “Open Proton sign-in”, finish in browser
steps.expected: “Waiting for your browser…” → “✓ Signed in as <email>”; Next enabled
Step 3 of 3 · chips for existing Documents/Pictures/Desktop, Documents + Pictures preselected

steps.action: Toggle Desktop on, click “+ Other folder…”, pick ~/Music
steps.expected: 4 chips selected, each pressed style
Home opens; status “Syncing N of M files”; arc animates; timeline gets entries
Status “Everything is up to date”; toast “Everything is up to date ✓”; panel icon idle
Progress shows
File deleted; message “The download didn't match Proton's checksum, so it was deleted. Try again.”; Next stays disabled

steps.action: Click the button again (mock now serves a good file)
steps.expected: ✓ Downloaded; Next enabled

steps.action: Click “Open Proton sign-in”, wait 5 min (mock clock)
steps.expected: “Sign-in didn't finish. Try again.”; button enabled
Step 1 with its ✓ state kept
Opens on the same step with the same state

title: Add a folder with the dialog

steps.expected: Add-folder dialog; focus on “Folder on this computer”
Inline error beside the field: “Already syncing”; Start disabled
Inline error “Pick a folder inside your home folder, not the whole home folder”
Proton folder prefilled “<root>/Startup”; Two-way selected
Dialog closes; Folders tab; new card “Startup · Measuring…”, status “First sync started…”; toast
Size chip shows a real size; status “Backed up HH:MM · N files”

title: Add a folder by drag and drop

steps.action: Drag a folder from the file manager onto the window
steps.expected: Drop highlight on the whole window
Add-folder dialog prefilled with that folder

steps.action: Drop a file instead of a folder
steps.expected: Toast “Drop a folder to sync it. To upload files, use Browse.”
Card dims; status “Off · not syncing”; ↻ Sync disabled; watching count drops
Status “Synced just now” after a sync
Toast “Agriland: ↑ Back up” with Undo
Confirm: “Two-way sync also sends deletions…” · “Switch to two-way” / “Keep ↑ Back up”
Mode stays Back up
Only this folder syncs; status updates; toast
File manager opens the local folder
Card disappears; toast “Stopped syncing Agriland · files kept on both sides” + Undo
Card returns exactly as before, still syncing

title: Sync now, Stop, Pause, Resume (everywhere stays consistent)

steps.expected: Header button becomes Stop; status “Syncing…”; transfer graph moves; panel icon syncing
Toast “Stopped at N of M · nothing lost”; no .kluis-part files left
Pressed style; amber “Paused”; Quick settings “Pause sync: On”; panel menu shows “Resume syncing”; graph flat 0

steps.action: Edit a file in a synced folder
steps.expected: Nothing uploads; status still paused

steps.action: Click “Resume syncing” in the panel menu
steps.expected: All three controls show resumed; the edited file uploads within 10 s
List with Files, Size, Modified columns; skeleton rows if loading > 300 ms
Breadcrumb “My files › Agriland”; its items listed
Progress, then both rows appear; toast “Uploaded 2 files ✓”

steps.action: Drag a file onto the list
steps.expected: Uploads into the current folder
Row appears; toast

steps.action: Select one file, click Rename, type new name
steps.expected: Row renamed; Rename disabled with 0 or 2+ selected
Files land in ~/Downloads; toast with “Show in folder”
Confirm “Move 2 items to the trash? …” · “Move to trash” / “Keep files” (no default)
Rows gone; toast + Undo (if restore is supported, §6)
Rows restored from the Proton trash

steps.action: Drag the Size column divider 60 px right; press ← twice on the Files divider
steps.expected: Columns resize; widths survive a restart
“This folder is empty. Drag files here to upload them.”
“Couldn't load this folder: offline” + Retry

title: Photos end to end
given: 2 years of photos (mock: 24 months, 5–15 per month, some videos)

steps.expected: Download and Upload cards collapsed (status line only, chevrons pointing down); gallery fills the rest; scrubber shows 24 dots + year labels

steps.action: Click anywhere on the Download header
steps.expected: Card opens, chevron up; path row, layout, albums, trash-follow visible
Toggles without opening/closing the card

steps.action: Click “Change…”, pick a folder; click the path
steps.expected: Path updates; the path opens the file manager
Next download uses YYYY/ folders (assert on disk)
Status “N new added · M skipped (already in Proton Photos)”

steps.action: Scroll the gallery with the mouse wheel to the bottom
steps.expected: Only the gallery scrolls; the ring moves monotonically, never jumps > 1 dot, ends exactly on the last dot
Gallery smooth-scrolls; “March 2025” heading at the top; ring on that dot
✓ badges; “3 selected”; Open disabled; Download selected enabled
Files saved to the download folder; toast; selection cleared
Opens in the default video player
Gallery and scrubber show only that album's months

title: Shared with me (only if the CLI supports it)

steps.expected: “0 of 3 items synced”; columns Permissions, Name, Shared by, Local folder, Shared on, Sync
Order flips; arrow ▼/▲

steps.action: Click the folder icon on row 1, pick ~/Documents/Papies
steps.expected: Path updates (dimmed until synced)
Toast “Syncing … to …”; “1 of 3 items synced”; files appear locally

steps.action: Switch Sync on for the Viewer item
steps.expected: Syncs as mirror-down; tooltip explains why
Toast “local copy kept”; files stay on disk

title: Activity
given: Log has ok, info, warning, error entries

steps.expected: Rows with coloured icons; sidebar badge clears
Only warnings + errors
File manager at ~/.local/state/kluis
Empty state, then the entries return
Dialog; first section “Your Proton Drive folder” with Location ✓ + Change…
Progress “Moving N of M files”; ends ✓; toast + Undo; no file missing at any point (assert)

steps.action: Toggle Start at login, Start hidden; set interval 30 min, theme Light, notifications Problems only
steps.expected: Each applies instantly; all persist after restart; autostart .desktop written/removed

steps.action: Click “Check now” under Proton Drive CLI
steps.expected: “Checking…” → “✓ Up to date” or update flow F15
Toast “Copied”; clipboard has versions + log, no email, no tokens (assert)
Confirm “Sign out” / “Stay signed in”
Sync stops; onboarding Step 2 opens; files untouched
⚙ All settings… → divider → “Quick settings” → Pause, Notifications, Dark mode, Start at login, VPN view
Menu drops down: Add folder, Settings, Run setup again, About Kluis, Quit
All → Problems only → Off → All; Settings shows the same value
Column disappears; button moves into the header after Pause; main area widens
Column stays collapsed
Status “Offline — will continue when you're back online”; no retry storm (backoff)
Resumes; no duplicate files (assert SHA-1s)
Folder paused, “Disk full on this computer”; resumes after space is freed
Notification + Home banner “Sign in again” → opens onboarding Step 2

steps.action: Unplug the drive holding a synced folder
steps.expected: Folder paused “Folder not found…”; nothing trashed remotely

steps.action: Delete 400 files locally in a two-way folder
steps.expected: Mass-deletion guard dialog; default keeps everything

steps.action: Edit the same file locally and remotely
steps.expected: Both kept: “name (conflict 2026-11-26 0942 <host>).ext”; activity warning
Resumes; no .kluis-part leftovers; nothing lost

steps.action: App start / daily check finds a new version
steps.expected: Downloads in the background, SHA-512 verified
Switches atomically; Settings shows the new version; activity entry; no prompt
Keeps the previous binary; one notification “Proton changed its Drive tool. Kluis needs an update for it.”; retries daily
Notification “Kluis 1.0.1 is available” + link; nothing installs

steps.action: Beta access off, only a pre-release exists
steps.expected: No notification
Hides; keeps syncing; first time: notification “Kluis keeps syncing in the background”
Same window comes back (single instance)

steps.action: Log out and in (Start at login + Start hidden)
steps.expected: Only the panel icon appears; syncing runs
Process ends; panel icon gone

steps.action: Keyboard only: Tab through every screen
steps.expected: Visible focus everywhere; every action reachable
Chip “VPN on”, “Showing as Zürich”; pin “You · Zürich (VPN)”
Within 2 s: chip “VPN off”, “Your location <home city>”; pin moves
Pin moves to the Australian capital

steps.action: No home city set and no VPN
steps.expected: Pin uses the city from the system time zone
Edit synced folder dialog, prefilled; button “Save”

steps.action: Open “More options”, switch off “Copy deletions to the other side”, Save
steps.expected: Deleting a file locally does not trash it remotely; the next sync brings it back
New .tmp files are never uploaded (assert)

steps.action: Switch off “Sync soon after I change files”
steps.expected: Edits wait for the next periodic check; status says so
Full rescan on the next sync; activity entry
Browse opens at the folder's remote path

steps.action: ⋯ More → Open Proton Drive on the web
steps.expected: Default browser opens drive.proton.me
